name: @scalemule/news-publication
description: Shared server framework for ScaleMule local news publications. Walnut Creek Times is the broadsheet default; each paper supplies its own identity and feature flags.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; if(!/^0\.(0|1)\.\d+$/.test(v)){console.error('ERR: SDK '+v+' violates patch-only policy (0.0.x or 0.1.x only). See CONTRIBUTING.md SDK versioning section.');process.exit(1)}" && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
